title: T3 live shell checklist
runtime_claim: Coverage design only. Every item starts not_exercised. No UI input, app launch, model request, build, setting change or process was performed by this author.

support_vocabulary.source_supported: Visible component/handler/menu or default binding exists in pinned source; installed availability still must be observed.
support_vocabulary.discovery_probe: Question deliberately left open; expected behavior is not claimed as implemented.
support_vocabulary.quality_probe: Interaction quality acceptance probe; source does not guarantee the outcome.

execution_notes: Parent alone owns all native/UI control.
Existing GPT-6.1 Sol subscription may be used by parent for its live audit; this checklist makes no model request.
Installed/custom shortcuts override defaults below; Cmd means macOS Mod.
Every conditional item needs a recorded availability reason; do not mark invisible/version-gated features failed by assumption.
Destructive/account/share/update paths are inspection only on existing data; use disposable audit state for reversible mutations.
A screenshot proves visible state; timed frames/video are needed for motion; interaction sequences are needed for routing, persistence and focus.
short_run: Record installed version, active thread/model label, window size, theme, current animation ms, and current surfaces (BASE-01–04).

Cycle left sidebar, right panel, thread details and terminal using their mouse controls and Cmd+B / Cmd+Option+B / Cmd+Shift+B / Cmd+J; capture before/intermediate/after and restore (SIDE-01, PANEL-01, WINDOW-08, MOTION-01–02).
Open right-panel launcher; inspect every available entry and disabled reason. Open Browser; focus it then Cmd+L; load a harmless public page with text and links (PANEL-02–04, BROWSER-01–02).
Exercise page history/reload/Stop; capture loaded versus loading geometry. Compare URL-hover Open in system browser with webpage/transcript link right-click menus (BROWSER-04–09).
Open More: Find with Enter/Shift+Enter/Escape, zoom/reset, appearance, device toolbar/presets/custom dimensions/rotate/lock; restore original page settings (BROWSER-15–25).
Float preview over chat and return; inspect separate-window/move-runtime availability. Capture screenshot and annotation comment into audit draft without sending from this checklist (BROWSER-26–33).

Add second Browser plus Files/Diff/PR/Linked PRs/Terminal/Device/Side chat as enabled; verify actual body and routing for each. Reorder/overflow/context-menu tabs, close and Cmd+Shift+T restore (PANEL-05–15).
Resize compact/wide, switch Browser→Files→Browser, close/reopen, A→B→A; maximize/restore and interrupt a drag. Record widths, focus and page bounds (PANEL-16–20, MOTION-03–07).
Work through sidebar search, project filter, thread selection/rename/context menu, shelves and footer PR/Usage/Settings routes. Use only audit rows for reversible state changes (SIDE-03–22).

Test window resize around980/767/760px when allowed, app/page focus and history boundaries, native menus, overlay click capture, narrow popups; restore initial geometry and leave no audit recording/overlay running (WINDOW-01–13).
